text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! Lord Trainer,
I have thoroughly rested and recuperated!"
choice_data_list: You're full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu. To be completely honest,
I was engaging in a certain form of training even during our rest."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That would be... Zazen. Days spent focusing the
mind, quietly looking back on the path one has
walked, and purging every worldly thought..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now filled with boundless energy and vitality, my spirits are at their absolute peak.
Please... grant me new training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Yaeno Muteki got the ideal amount of rest!
